benchmark_status: INTERNAL ENGINEERING ANALYSIS ONLY. SIMULATED TTFAR IS NOT A MEASUREMENT OF REAL-WORLD K SCAN SPEED.
rule: Every parameter the structural model consumes is declared here with its evidence class. A parameter absent from this register cannot be supplied to the model — lib/model.js throws rather than defaulting, because a silent default is how an invented number becomes a conclusion.

observed_evidence_source.ancestry: PROVEN ancestor of the lab base SHA (git merge-base --is-ancestor -> true, 151 commits behind).

validity_check.note: git diff 6e7e005..909df86 shows ZERO changes to these files, so client-side OBSERVED timing remains structurally applicable at the lab base.
validity_check.stale_consequence: The SCAN-006 weak-query repair landed between the measured SHA and the lab base. It moved garments that previously short-circuited at discoveryMs=0 into the real provider path, so the OBSERVED commerce OUTCOME MIX (6/13 weak_query) is STALE at the lab base. The OBSERVED per-request latency bands are not invalidated by that change, but MORE requests are now exposed to them.

parameters.source: docs/BUILD34_SCANNER_SCAN_RESULTS_DEEP_AUDIT.md:288 — `gemini_success elapsedMs=…` across 8 live App Staging scans
parameters.why: The conclusion is that identification dominates the first-result path. At 1/3 of the low value (1.6 s) Gemini is still the single largest server term; at 3x the high value it exceeds the 14 s timeout and the request fails outright. The ordering conclusion is robust across the whole range.

parameters.source: MODELED. No per-provider measurement exists. Calibration anchor: the audit OBSERVED the whole fast fan-out at discoveryMs 1037-1447 with early=true (audit doc:180), which bounds the FIRST-delivering child, not either child individually.
parameters.why: The conclusion that the fast path is deadline-bound survives: at 3x the high value every child exceeds FAST_COMMERCE_DEADLINE_MS=1900 and the group times out, which is exactly the OBSERVED 4/13 timeout outcome. At 1/3 the low value the group completes comfortably and the deadline stops binding. So the sweep, not a point value, is the reportable result.

parameters.source: Derived. Source geometry is PROVEN (read from the committed fixture JPEG headers); the quality-0.65 bytes-per-pixel coefficient is MODELED from the OBSERVED bpp range of those same fixtures.
